1: import Phaser from 'phaser';
2: import { clipKey, manifest, terrainId, tilesTexture } from '../assets';
3: import { COLS, ROWS, TILE, WIDTH, HEIGHT, GRAVITY } from '../main';
4: import { state } from '../state';
5: import { sfx } from '../sfx';
6: import { Climbable, Joe } from '../joe';
7: import { HUD_HEIGHT, Hud, packFull } from '../hud';
8: import { DoorDef, Facing, RoomDef, START_ROOM, room } from '../rooms';
9: import { Mover, World } from '../world';
10: 
11: /** What an ASCII cell holds that is not part of the scenery. */
12: interface Pickup {
13:   sprite: Phaser.GameObjects.Sprite;
14:   kind: string;
15:   points?: number;
16:   /** The texture it puts in Joe's pocket, when it takes one of the five slots. */
17:   carry?: string;
18: }
19: 
20: interface Creature {
21:   mover: Mover;
22:   view: Phaser.GameObjects.Sprite;
23:   kind: 'skull' | 'skeleton';
24:   dir: number;
25:   dead: boolean;
26:   /** Early levels: the creature does not come back after it has caught Joe once. */
27:   spent: boolean;
28: }
29: 
30: interface Crumble {
31:   col: number;
32:   row: number;
33:   view: Phaser.GameObjects.Image;
34:   timer: number;
35:   state: 'solid' | 'falling' | 'gone';
36: }
37: 
38: const WALL = '#';
39: const PLATFORM = '=';
40: const LADDER = 'H';
41: const ROPE = 'R';
42: const FIRE = '^';
43: const CRUMBLE = 'x';
44: 
45: const DOOR_TINT: Record<string, number> = { gold: 0xffd34d, silver: 0xd8d8e0, red: 0xff5a4d };
46: /** Jewels by colour: the deeper the colour, the more it is worth, as in the original. */
47: const JEWELS = [
48:   { tint: 0x7fd4ff, points: 500 },
49:   { tint: 0x9dffb0, points: 300 },
50:   { tint: 0xfff2a8, points: 200 },
51:   { tint: 0xffffff, points: 100 },
52: ];
53: /** Brush sizes (canvas textures) for the two light radii: no torch, and torch. */
54: const DARK_R = 112;
55: const LIT_R = 156;
56: 
57: export class Room extends Phaser.Scene {
58:   private def!: RoomDef;
59:   private defId = START_ROOM;
60:   private grid: string[][] = [];
61:   private joe!: Joe;
62:   private hud!: Hud;
63:   private pickups: Pickup[] = [];
64:   private creatures: Creature[] = [];
65:   private crumbles: Crumble[] = [];
66:   private climbables: Climbable[] = [];
67:   private doors: (DoorDef & { view: Phaser.GameObjects.Image; zone: Phaser.GameObjects.Rectangle })[] = [];
68:   private idol: Phaser.GameObjects.Image | null = null;
69:   private darkness: Phaser.GameObjects.RenderTexture | null = null;
70:   private spawn: [number, number] = [1, ROWS - 2];
71:   private face: Facing = 'E';
72:   private nextRoom: { roomId: string; spawn?: [number, number]; face?: Facing } | null = null;
73:   /** Set while a room change, a death or the end of the bonus is under way. */
74:   private busy = false;
75:   private bonusMode = false;
76:   private bonusLeft = 0;
77:   private frozen = false;
78:   private keys!: Record<string, Phaser.Input.Keyboard.Key>;
79:   /** The crumbling floors that have let go, shared by everyone in the room. */
80:   private gone = new Set<string>();
81: 
82:   constructor() {
83:     super('room');
84:   }
85: 
86:   /** What Joe and the creatures can walk into, and what they can stand on. */
87:   private world: World = {
88:     solid: (col, row) => {
89:       if (col < 0 || col >= COLS || row < 0 || row >= ROWS) return true;
90:       return this.grid[row][col] === WALL;
91:     },
92:     ledge: (col, row, gone) => {
93:       if (col < 0 || col >= COLS || row < 0 || row >= ROWS) return false;
94:       const c = this.grid[row][col];
95:       return c === PLATFORM || (c === CRUMBLE && !gone.has(`${col},${row}`));
96:     },
97:   };
98: 
99:   init(data: { roomId?: string; spawn?: [number, number]; face?: Facing; level?: number } = {}) {
100:     const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
101:     // Room changes inside the game always carry their own data; only a fresh page load reads the query string.
102:     const fresh = data.roomId === undefined;
103:     this.defId = data.roomId ?? params.get('room') ?? START_ROOM;
104:     // ?level= opens the pyramid at a depth, so a room can be looked at as it is deeper down.
105:     const level = Number(data.level ?? (fresh ? params.get('level') : null));
106:     if (Number.isFinite(level) && level > 0) state.level = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
107:     const def = room(this.defId);
108:     const marker = def.rows.findIndex((r) => r.includes('@'));
109:     this.spawn = data.spawn ?? (marker >= 0 ? [def.rows[marker].indexOf('@'), marker] : [1, ROWS - 2]);
110:     this.face = data.face ?? 'E';
111:     this.bonusMode = this.defId === 'bonus';
112:     this.bonusLeft = this.bonusMode ? 30 : 0;
113:     this.busy = false;
114:     this.nextRoom = null;
115:     this.gone = new Set<string>();
116:   }
117: 
118:   // ---- building --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
119: 
120:   tileAt(col: number, row: number): string {
121:     if (col < 0 || col >= COLS || row < 0 || row >= ROWS) return WALL;
122:     return this.grid[row][col] ?? ' ';
123:   }
124: 
125:   private centre(col: number, row: number) {
126:     return { x: col * TILE + TILE / 2, y: row * TILE + TILE / 2 };
127:   }
128: 
129:   create() {
130:     if (!manifest(this)) {
131:       this.scene.start('title');
132:       return;
133:     }
134:     this.def = room(this.defId);
135:     this.grid = this.def.rows.map((r) => r.padEnd(COLS, ' ').split(''));
136:     this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#0b0709');
137:     this.cameras.main.fadeIn(220, 0, 0, 0);
138: 
139:     const kb = this.input.keyboard;
140:     const K = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.KeyCodes;
141:     this.keys = {
142:       left: kb!.addKey(K.LEFT),
143:       a: kb!.addKey(K.A),
144:       right: kb!.addKey(K.RIGHT),
145:       d: kb!.addKey(K.D),
146:       up: kb!.addKey(K.UP),
147:       w: kb!.addKey(K.W),
148:       down: kb!.addKey(K.S),
149:       space: kb!.addKey(K.SPACE),
150:     };
151: 
152:     this.drawScenery();
153:     this.buildClimbables();
154:     this.buildCrumbles();
155:     this.buildFires();
156:     this.buildPickups();
157:     this.buildIdol();
158:     this.buildDoors();
159:     this.buildCreatures();
160:     this.buildJoe();
161:     this.buildDarkness();
162:     this.buildHud();
163: 
164:     this.cameras.main.once('camerafadeoutcomplete', () => {
165:       // nextRoom names a room in the pyramid, not a scene: the game is one scene that rebuilds itself.
166:       if (this.nextRoom) this.scene.start('room', this.nextRoom);
167:       else this.scene.start('gameover');
168:     });
169:   }
170: 
171:   /** A scenery sprite from the manifest, sitting on the floor of its cell. */
172:   private addProp(name: string, col: number, row: number, depth: number, scale = 0.8) {
173:     const e = manifest(this)?.sprites[name];
174:     if (!e || !this.textures.exists(e.textureKey)) return null;
175:     return this.add
176:       .image(col * TILE + TILE / 2, (row + 1) * TILE, e.textureKey)
177:       .setOrigin(0.5, 0.95)
178:       .setDepth(depth)
179:       .setScale(scale);
180:   }
181: 
182:   /** The background, the walls and the platforms, painted with the generated ground tiles. */
183:   private drawScenery() {
184:     const tex = tilesTexture(this);
185:     if (!tex) return;
186:     const at = (terrain: string, col: number, row: number) =>
187:       this.add.image(col * TILE, row * TILE, tex, terrainId(this, terrain)).setOrigin(0).setDepth(0);
188:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
189:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
190:         const c = this.grid[row][col];
191:         if (c === WALL) at('brick', col, row);
192:         else if (c === PLATFORM) at('stone', col, row);
193:         else if (c === CRUMBLE) at('floor', col, row);
194:         else if (c === FIRE) at('ember', col, row);
195:         else at('void', col, row);
196:       }
197:     }
198:     // A lit top edge on every ledge, so the platforms read as platforms.
199:     const g = this.add.graphics().setDepth(1);
200:     g.fillStyle(0xc8a86c, 0.85);
201:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
202:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
203:         const c = this.grid[row][col];
204:         if ((c === PLATFORM || c === CRUMBLE) && this.tileAt(col, row - 1) === '.') g.fillRect(col * TILE, row * TILE, TILE, 3);
205:       }
206:     }
207:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
208:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
209:         const c = this.grid[row][col];
210:         if (c !== 'W' && c !== 'B' && c !== 'V' && c !== 'T') continue;
211:         const name = c === 'W' ? 'web' : c === 'B' ? 'skull_pile' : c === 'V' ? 'vase' : 'torch';
212:         const img = this.addProp(name, col, row, 5, c === 'V' ? 0.7 : c === 'T' ? 1.3 : 0.9);
213:         if (!img) continue;
214:         if (c === 'V') img.setTint(0xd8b48a);
215:         if (c === 'T') {
216:           img.setBlendMode(Phaser.BlendModes.ADD).setTint(0xffc27a);
217:           this.tweens.add({ targets: img, alpha: 0.75, duration: 420, yoyo: true, repeat: -1 });
218:         }
219:       }
220:     }
221:   }
222: 
223:   private buildClimbables() {
224:     for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
225:       let start = -1;
226:       for (let row = 0; row <= ROWS; row++) {
227:         const c = row < ROWS ? this.grid[row][col] : ' ';
228:         const rope = c === ROPE;
229:         if ((c === LADDER || rope) && start < 0) start = row;
230:         if (c !== LADDER && !rope && start >= 0) {
231:           const climb: Climbable = { col, top: start, bottom: row - 1, rope };
232:           this.climbables.push(climb);
233:           this.drawClimbable(climb);
234:           start = -1;
235:         }
236:       }
237:     }
238:   }
239: 
240: // FB-002: ladders and ropes are drawn because the generated ladder prop renders as a 12-pixel-wide 3D ladder
241: // seen at an angle, which cannot be read in a flat side view. Delete this when the library has a 2D ladder.
242: private drawClimbable(c: Climbable) {
243:     const top = c.top * TILE;
244:     const bottom = (c.bottom + 1) * TILE;
245:     const x = c.col * TILE + TILE / 2;
246:     const g = this.add.graphics().setDepth(8);
247:     const wood = c.rope ? 0x9a7440 : 0xc9a25e;
248:     const shade = c.rope ? 0x6a4c26 : 0x8a6a3c;
249:     if (c.rope) {
250:       g.lineStyle(3, wood, 1).lineBetween(x, top, x, bottom);
251:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillCircle(x, bottom - 4, 4);
252:       return;
253:     }
254:     // Two rails and the rungs between them.
255:     for (const dx of [-8, 8]) {
256:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1.5, top, 3, bottom - top);
257:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1, top, 2, bottom - top);
258:     }
259:     for (let y = top + 8; y < bottom - 2; y += 11) {
260:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x - 10, y, 20, 4);
261:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x - 9, y + 1, 18, 2);
262:     }
263:   }
264: 
265:   private buildCrumbles() {
266:     const tex = tilesTexture(this);
267:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
268:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
269:         if (this.grid[row][col] !== CRUMBLE) continue;
270:         const view = this.add
271:           .image(col * TILE, row * TILE, tex ?? '__DEFAULT', terrainId(this, 'floor'))
272:           .setOrigin(0)
273:           .setDepth(1)
274:           .setTint(0xbb9259);
275:         this.crumbles.push({ col, row, view, timer: 0, state: 'solid' });
276:       }
277:     }
278:   }
279: 
280:   private buildFires() {
281:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
282:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
283:         if (this.grid[row][col] !== FIRE) continue;
284:         const img = this.addProp('flame', col, row, 20, 1.15);
285:         if (!img) continue;
286:         img.setBlendMode(Phaser.BlendModes.ADD);
287:         this.tweens.add({ targets: img, y: img.y - 5, scaleY: 1.25, duration: 330, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, ease: 'Sine.inOut' });
288:       }
289:     }
290:   }
291: 
292:   private buildPickups() {
293:     const table: Record<string, [string, string, number?, string?]> = {
294:       y: ['key_gold', 'key:gold', 25],
295:       w: ['key_silver', 'key:silver', 25],
296:       e: ['key_red', 'key:red', 25],
297:       j: ['jewel', 'jewel', 100],
298:       o: ['gold', 'gold', 50],
299:       t: ['torch', 'torch', 50, 'torch'],
300:       d: ['sword', 'sword', 50, 'sword'],
301:     };
302:     for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
303:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
304:         const t = table[this.grid[row][col]];
305:         if (!t) continue;
306:         const e = manifest(this)?.sprites[t[0]];
307:         if (!e || !this.textures.exists(e.textureKey)) continue;
308:         const { x, y } = this.centre(col, row);
309:         const sprite = this.add.sprite(x, y, e.textureKey).setDepth(45);
310:         // The original's jewels come in several colours and the rarer ones are worth more. The generated gem is a
311:         // dark ruby, so the colour is added on top rather than multiplied: the shape and its shading stay.
312:         if (t[1] === 'jewel') {
313:           const k = (col + row) % JEWELS.length;
314:           sprite.setBlendMode(Phaser.BlendModes.ADD).setTint(JEWELS[k].tint);
315:           this.pickups.push({ sprite, kind: t[1], points: JEWELS[k].points, carry: t[3] });
316:         } else {
317:           this.pickups.push({ sprite, kind: t[1], points: t[2], carry: t[3] });
318:         }
319:         const key = clipKey(this, t[0], 'bob');
320:         if (key) sprite.play(key);
321:       }
322:     }
323:   }
324: 
325:   private buildIdol() {
326:     if (!this.def.idol) return;
327:     const e = manifest(this)?.sprites.jewel;
328:     if (!e) return;
329:     const [col, row] = this.def.idol;
330:     const { x, y } = this.centre(col, row);
331:     this.idol = this.add.image(x, y, e.textureKey).setDepth(46).setScale(2.6).setTint(0xffe9a0).setBlendMode(Phaser.BlendModes.ADD);
332:     this.tweens.add({ targets: this.idol, y: y - 5, duration: 900, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, ease: 'Sine.inOut' });
333:   }
334: 
335:   /** A door is an opening in the brick with the door standing in it, tinted with the key it wants. */
336:   private buildDoors() {
337:     for (const d of this.def.doors) {
338:       const e = manifest(this)?.sprites.door;
339:       if (!e || !this.textures.exists(e.textureKey)) continue;
340:       const { x, y } = this.centre(d.x, d.y);
341:       // The hole in the wall, lit by the key that opens it, with the door standing in it. In the original the
342:       // colour of the doorway is how you know which key it wants, so that is what this shows.
343:       this.add.rectangle(x, y, TILE, TILE, 0x0d0809).setDepth(28);
344:       this.add.rectangle(x, y, TILE, TILE, DOOR_TINT[d.colour], 0.16).setDepth(28);
345:       const frame = this.add.graphics().setDepth(29);
346:       frame.lineStyle(2, DOOR_TINT[d.colour], 0.85);
347:       frame.strokeRect(x - TILE / 2 + 1, y - TILE / 2 + 1, TILE - 2, TILE - 2);
348:       const view = this.add.image(x, y + 3, e.textureKey).setDepth(30).setScale(1.45).setTint(DOOR_TINT[d.colour]);
349:       const zone = this.add
350:         .rectangle(d.dir === 'left' ? x + TILE / 2 + 4 : x - TILE / 2 - 4, y, 16, TILE + 8, 0xffffff, 0)
351:         .setDepth(31);
352:       this.doors.push({ ...d, view, zone });
353:     }
354:   }
355: 
356:   private buildCreatures() {
357:     const place = (kind: 'skull' | 'skeleton', col: number, row: number) => {
358:       const name = kind === 'skull' ? 'skull' : 'skeleton';
359:       const e = manifest(this)?.sprites[name];
360:       if (!e || !this.textures.exists(e.textureKey)) return;
361:       const { x, y } = this.centre(col, row);
362:       const view = this.add.sprite(x, y, e.textureKey).setDepth(55);
363:       const mover = new Mover();
364:       mover.x = x;
365:       mover.y = (row + 1) * TILE;
366:       mover.w = kind === 'skull' ? 20 : 22;
367:       mover.h = kind === 'skull' ? 22 : 46;
368:       mover.gone = this.gone;
369:       view.setPosition(mover.x, mover.y - mover.h);
370:       this.creatures.push({ mover, view, kind, dir: col % 2 ? 1 : -1, dead: false, spent: false });
